capabilities: Browse and manage notes in a hierarchical file tree with a configurable separator
Look up, open and create notes through fuzzy search
Rename notes with a built-in renaming modal
Auto-generate frontmatter properties (ID, title, description, created, tags) for new notes
Render wikilinks and embeds with a Dendron-like resolver
extras: Canvas file support is experimental and must be enabled in settings; full documentation lives on a separate Wiki rather than the README; the author accepts GitHub Sponsors support.
intentEvidence: The original plugin became inactive, so it was forked to continue development
motivation: The original plugin became inactive, so the author forked it to continue development as it was used daily and improvement was desired.
problem: Obsidian's default file explorer and quick switcher don't show or manage hierarchies encoded in note names themselves, such as dot-separated paths.

relations.evidence: The original plugin became inactive, so it was forked to continue development
Dobrovolsky Bohdan for his amazing work on Structured, which this plugin gets some inspiration from

summary: File explorer that browses, creates, renames and manages hierarchical notes whose names are separated by a configurable separator.
